subject: Question about Visualization Case in ggplot2

messages.author: e7a71d967e60bb41
messages.subject: Question about Visualization Case in ggplot2
parts:
Dear All,
I recently came across this website

http://bit.ly/a6v42Q

and was impressed by the first visualization.
I am not sure whether it should be considered a network visualization
or, loosely speaking, a statistical chart, but I wonder if anything
along those lines can be generated with ggplot2. Even a (very)
simplified, self-contained example would help (in particular I am
thinking about the case of children in grades 1 to 5 moving between 10
rooms).
Any suggestion is appreciated.
Cheers

Lorenzo

messages.author: ba9318fcb03a20d0
messages.subject: Re: Question about Visualization Case in ggplot2
parts:
You could try using geom_smooth and be creative in your line widths. You
would have to put anchor
points between each endpoint to get the smooth curve between each room
for each child, and
some alpha blending to make things nice.

Nicholas
